name: d3-auth
description: Self-hosted OpenID Connect provider with per-app roles — D3 Cloud

scripts.dev:up: node scripts/dev-env.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build --wait && pnpm dev:seed
scripts.dev:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T server node dist/cli/dev-seed.js /app/dev/seed.dev.json && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait --no-deps --force-recreate server
